name: @jewellery-erp/desktop-electron
description: Jewellery ERP & POS — offline desktop application (Electron + local SQLite backend)

scripts.package: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm --publish never

author: Shri Jewellers
